content.title: Louisville vs USF score today, NCAA Tournament TV channel, highlights
content.text: Updated March 19, 2026, 9:34 p.m. ETCoverage from the game:UofL basketball stifles USF in March Madness, reaches NCAA Round of 32Brown: Ryan Conwell, Isaac McKneely must carry Louisville through March MadnessLouisville vs. Michigan State prediction: Our pick for second-round gameCoverage during the game:BUFFALO, NY — The margin for error in the NCAA Tournament is razor thin, especially when you're down a starting point guard.One false move from sixth-seeded Louisville basketball today against No. 11 South Florida at KeyBank Center, and Pat Kelsey's Cardinals could see their season take a nosedive steeper than Niagara Falls — to a point of no return. Freshman Mikel Brown Jr., who was ruled out due to a reaggravated back injury Wednesday, will watch from the bench — and won't return for Round 2 this weekend if his team pulls off the victory."Everybody's fighting for their lives," Isaac McKneely told reporters Monday. "It brings a whole new level of intensity."Tipoff is set for 1:30 p.m.UofL enters its first back-to-back March Madness appearances in more than a decade with a record of 23-10. Kelsey's team is coming off a 1-1 trip to the ACC Tournament — beating SMU, then falling to Miami in last Thursday's quarterfinal round."The biggest thing, going into this, is having the best culture (and) having the best chemistry," Ryan Conwell said. "Every team is going to be talented; every team is going to have their strengths and weaknesses."Led by first-year coach Bryan Hodgson, the Bulls arrived at the Big Dance tied with No. 1 overall seed Duke for the nation's third-longest winning streak (11 in a row). They're 25-8 and earned an automatic bid by capturing the American Athletic Conference Tournament title, 70-55 over Wichita State on Sunday."I can tell you this," Kelsey said Wednesday. "Both the people who are here in the building and then the people who are watching around the country at home on their television — or wherever the heck they're watching it — they're going to be entertained. It's going to be a really, really fun game."UofL owns a 29-4 record against USF dating back to 1985, including a 2-0 mark on neutral courts. The programs have shared four conferences over the years (Metro, Conference USA, Big East and American) but haven't met since Feb. 18, 2014 — an 80-54 victory for Louisville at the KFC Yum! Center.Follow along with live updates from KeyBank Center below:Isaac McKneely talks Louisville's NCAA Tournament win vs USFHere's what Isaac McKneely said after his big performance powered the Cards to victory vs. the Bulls:Ryan Conwell reflects on Louisville's NCAA Tournament win vs USFHere's what Conwell had to say after the Cards took care of business against the Bulls:FINAL | Louisville 83, South Florida 793:19, 2H | Louisville 77, USF 70The Cards seemed to be losing gas as the Bulls have used full court pressure to slowly chip away at their deficit. UoL has matched its first half turnover total and now has 20 for the game.7:21, 2H | Louisville 72, South Florida 61Isaac McKneely leads the Cards with 20 points. He's accounted for half of their 12 3-pointers.Ryan Conwell is the only other UofL player in double digits with 16.Louisville has led by as many as 23 points this half.15:32, 2H | Louisville 51, USF 35The Cards have reeled off a 10-2 run to post their biggest lead in the game so far. Ryan Conwell has led the way scoring eight points on 3-for-3 shooting this half to bring his game total to 13.Halftime | Louisville 37, USF 27Isaac McKneely scored 11 points and made three 3-pointers to lead the Cards to a 10-point cushion at intermission. UofL dominated the boards in the first half, outrebounding USF 27-17, but the key to its early lead has been defensively. The Bulls shot just 28.6% from the floor through the first 20 minutes.4:00, 1H | Louisville 30, USF 20UofL coach Pat Kelsey called a timeout after consecutive turnovers led to back-to-back dunks for the Bulls. The Cards have now committed eight turnovers in the first half, but the Bulls have managed just six points off them.7:46, 1H | Louisville 24, USF 11The Cards have had five different players make a 3-pointer and have shot 5-for-11 from behind the arc. Ironically, the team's leader in 3s, Ryan Conwell, has yet to connect from deep.USF shot 33% from 3 on the season but so far are 1-for-12.10:32, 1H | Louisville 17, South Florida 9The Cards just ripped off a 12-2 run over the past 4:32.The Bulls are 1 for their last 9 from the field.14:57, 1H | Louisville 7, South Florida 7The Cards and the Bulls went a combined 6 for 19 from the field during the opening segment.UofL asserted itself on the boards, with nine rebounds to USF's four.Louisville vs USF starting lineups for March MadnessHere are UofL's starters:Adrian WooleyIsaac McKneelyRyan ConwellJ'Vonne HadleyVangelis ZougrisHere are USF's starters:Wes EnisJoseph PinionJosh OmojafoCJ BrownIzaiyah NelsonWhat channel is Louisville vs South Florida on today in March Madness?TV channel: TNTStream: NCAA March Madness Live app | Sling TVLouisville vs. South Florida will air on TNT.
